value: All private residential lease contracts entered into after the Act's entry into force, including renewals, must be registered; unregistered contracts are null and void. The lessor must register the contract with the Authority within 30 days of the start of the lease (art. 4).
A long private residential lease cannot have a duration of less than one year; an agreement stipulating a shorter duration is deemed agreed for at least one year (art. 8).

Rent increases may take place only once every year. Without an express agreement the rent cannot be revised during the term. Yearly increases may not exceed the annual variation of the Property Price Index published by the National Statistics Office (average of the previous four quarters), and may never exceed the previous rent by more than five percent; a negative variation does not reduce rent (art. 14).

note: No cap found in the Act text read; the Act allows the lessor to request a security amount (art. 6(1)(f)). Left blank.
